name: Commission Type 6 Code
definition: Specifies the type of investment fund commission.

FEND.name: Front End Load
FEND.definition: Commission for subscribing to an investment, paid at the time of the subscription.

BEND.name: Back End Load
BEND.definition: Commission for redeeming an investment, when an investor redeems an investment fund within a certain period of time.

CDPL.name: Commission De Placement
CDPL.definition: Amount of cash due to an intermediary for selling a product, or services, to a third party.
